description: 寶山第二水庫集水區範圍圖 [dams, reservoirs and flood defences] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 經濟部水利署. 寶山第二水庫集水區範圍位於新竹縣寶山鄉山湖村境內，攔蓄峨眉溪支流石井溪及由上坪堰越域引入頭前溪支流上坪溪等水源，供應家用及公共給水、農業用水、工業用水及水力用水等多目標使用，是一座離槽水庫。 本水庫集水區範圍係以寶山第二水庫大壩以上全流域稜線以內所涵蓋之區域為原則劃設而成，集水區面積約2. 83平方公里。 經濟部水利署北區水資源局於101... Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 經濟部水利署. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv, json, xml. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
